items.title: Freehand raises $75M Series B to scale supply-chain AI agents at Fortune 500

key_claims.claim: $75M Series B co-led by Battery Ventures and NewRoad Capital Partners; $100M total raised
Active clients: Meta, Unilever, J&J, Pfizer, Dunkin', Cardinal Health
5–10% spend recovered; 5–7× faster workflows; 70%+ procure-to-pay reduction
key_claims.source: freehand.ai (primary — vendor-reported, no independent audit cited)

caveats: Performance figures are vendor-reported with no independent audit or named methodology cited

items.title: Hush Security raises $30M Series A to govern enterprise AI agent identities

key_claims.claim: $30M Series A; $41M total raised; Akamai as strategic investor
JIT permissions at runtime, credential elimination, centralized kill switch, agent registry
Gartner: Fortune 500 will run 150,000+ agents by 2028, up from <15 today
key_claims.source: PR Newswire (Gartner cited in release; original Gartner report not independently retrieved)

caveats: Gartner forecast cited via press release only; original Gartner research not independently verified in this run

items.title: Claude Mythos Preview discovers two cryptographic attack improvements at ~$100k per finding
items.coi: Anthropic reports on its own unreleased model; no independent reproduction of findings confirmed in this run

key_claims.claim: HAWK attack cost reduced from 2^64 to 2^38 key recovery operations
AES 7-round attack: 200–800× faster than prior best via Möbius Bridge fingerprinting
API compute cost: ~$100,000 per attack finding
HAWK discovery time: 60 hours of semi-autonomous work
Methodology: multi-worker AI agents using Python, Sage, literature review, experimental validation

caveats: Vendor-conducted research using an unreleased model; no independent team has reproduced findings
Both attacks target non-production systems (HAWK undeployed; AES attack on 7-round research variant only)

items.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M multi-year AWS compute deal

key_claims.claim: Beat two-year human leaderboard record; SOTA across 3 benchmarks
key_claims.source: AWS primary (vendor-claimed; specific benchmarks not named)
TechCrunch citing CEO Socher (intent, not formal commitment)

caveats: Benchmark claims (leaderboard record, SOTA on 3 benchmarks) are vendor-reported; specific benchmarks and baselines not disclosed
October 2026 product timeline is a CEO statement, not a company commitment
items.conflicts: Deal value: AWS primary reports $410M; TechCrunch headline rounds to $400M. Reconciliation: AWS is the signing party and authoritative source. $410M used throughout.
